facts.fact_text: On 13 October 2008, the applicant applied to the Budapest Police Department for authorisation for a political demonstration in front of Parliament, in Kossuth Square.
Kossuth Square is a vast open area traditionally used for political demonstrations.
The planned demonstration was scheduled for Friday, 17 October 2008.
On 15 October 2008, the Budapest Police Department forbade the applicant's planned demonstration.
The Budapest Police Department was of the view that the planned demonstration would 'gravely endanger' the functioning of Parliament.
The Budapest Police Department considered that 'gravely endangering' the functioning of Parliament was a legitimate ground for prohibiting the demonstration under section 8(1) of the Assembly Act.
